log.user: explain what a database index is
log.ai: An index is basically a lookup table that helps the database find rows faster, like a book's index letting you jump straight to a page. It speeds up searches but slows down writes because the database has to update it every time data changes.

A cache is just a temporary storage spot where your computer or browser saves copies of frequently used files so it doesn't have to download them every time. It makes things load faster, but if you don't clear it regularly, it can slow down your device over time.

log.user: explain what a database index is
log.ai: Think of a database index like the index at the back of a book; instead of flipping through pages, it lets you jump straight to the specific data you need. Basically, it speeds up searches by keeping sorted copies of key columns so the database doesn't have to scan every single row every time.
